complexity.notes: The index()-based index recovery is O(n) per call and mutates the input via pop(); sorting (value, original_index) pairs would avoid this entirely. A hash map would give O(n) average time, and the loop lacks a termination guard if no valid pair exists (it would raise IndexError rather than exit cleanly).
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array and uses a two-pointer scan from both ends to find the pair summing to target, then recovers the original indices via linear index() lookups (with a pop-and-research workaround for duplicate values).
